_notes.roleSeparation: No address may appear in both `recyclers` and `auditors`. RECYCLER produces reports, AUDITOR authorises the payout; one key holding both is the treasury-drain path of docs/plan/security-audit-remediation.md section 3.1. script/ManageRoles.s.sol aborts if this file violates the rule, and addresses in `admins`/`emergency` must not appear in either operational list.
_notes.fundWallets: ADVISORY ONLY. `recyclerFunds`/`auditorFunds` record the wallet each principal is expected to register; no script applies them. `RecyReport.setFundsWallet(address)` is self-service, so each principal must call it from its own key.
_notes.unlockDelay: 3600 on the local dev chain (the on-chain minimum: the Phase 2 implementation enforces MIN_UNLOCK_DELAY = 1 hour at BOTH initialize and setUnlockDelay, so 60 is no longer deployable). Local claim flows warp time anyway - script/PopulateRecyReport.s.sol warps unlockDelay + 300 automatically. Public networks use 86400.
